Delicious and CHEAP
Jan 2019 • Family
Located at an alley behind the Nanci Mosque, Pho Muslim is a gem of a place. Not much to say on decor or appeal, but you are there to eat delicious Pho and thats what you will get. No fuss bowl of Pho with fresh herbs, homemade peanut chili paste to add more flavor to the already flavorful broth and don't forget to ask for a baguette for dipping (surprising good and fresh) and of course, ice coffee (vietnamese style). The whole experience will cost you no more than 50K VND.. Can't get any cheaper. If you are looking for HALAL Pho, don't go elsewhere. If you want delicious and cheap Pho, this is the place.

Delicious pho and cute owner who speaks malay!
Nov 2018 • Friends
Note : This is at DISTRICT 1 NOT 5 as shown above. It is very important as we input the address on GRAB as Tripadvisor and we were brought to a different (and much further place). To be safe, put your grab to the mosque nearby masjid (thanh duong) jamiul islamiyah.

On to the pho, it was so light and delicious! Pricing was on point and even the ice milo tastes so much better than the shop i had at bu vien street! 

This place is a must for all tourists who want to try authentic pho! The owner also speaks malay so it is very easy to communicate and he likes to strike a conversation with us (we went at 11am and ate there, we were the last customer on a weekday)

The best Pho Muslim In this World
Apr 2018 • Friends
Pho Muslim (not in Halal Amin restaurant at Malaysian Street) is Located at distrik 5 Ho chi minh city. The area of pho muslim usually call Nanci's area, there are also Masjid Jamiul Muslimin that call Nancis Mosque. If u stay near distrik 1, u can reach this area by using Bus Number 1 and take it from ben than market. This Pho Muslim is very delicious for me, u only pay for VND 40.000 but is very satisfying. The meat, the noodles, and the soup is soooo delicious. I recommended this one for u all traveler, not only muslim traveler. The taste it so really vietnamese traditional, and the portion not make u dissapointed.
